messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer ACME reported a sharp p99 increase on chat endpoint starting ~02:10 UTC. No obvious traffic spike. trace_id=acme-7f2
chris: putting it in triage. which model/variant?
maria: hosted/gpt-chat-v2:quant8, mostly short conversations (~32 tokens). p50 ok, p95 up ~30%, p99 up ~120%.
sahil: hmm short seqs + quantized = usually flashattn wins. any recent kernel heuristics changed?
maria: yeah, runtime rollout 02:05 toggled the new "attn_hysteresis" + sdpa preference heuristic. referenced rollout id r-2024-11-05-A
jen: opsbot, can you fetch recent kernel selection logs for routed requests to ACME?
opsbot: @jen fetching logs from 02:00-02:20 UTC for model gpt-chat-v2:quant8, customer ACME. Returning sample lines...
opsbot: ```
2024-11-05T02:07:12Z selecting kernel sdpa_permute for seq_len=32, batch=1, device=A100-80G
2024-11-05T02:07:12Z chosen variant sdpa_fused_kv
2024-11-05T02:07:12Z runtime: kv_cache_path hot
2024-11-05T02:09:45Z fallback flashattn_sync (50ms) -> sdpa (120ms)
```
chris: that fallback time looks weird — fallback to sdpa is slower here. did compileflag -Oattn_sdpa change?
sahil: i saw a change: compileflag SDPA_FUSE_PERMUTE=1 turned on in the canary at 02:03. might increase kernel prep for small batch.
maria: customer repro steps: cURL to /v1/chat with model gpt-chat-v2:quant8, stream=false, 32-token prompt. gave a linking script.
chris: can we repro locally with same GPU type? I can spin an A100-80GB in staging.
jen: short-term mitigation: pin routing policy to prefer flashattn for that model for ACME. ops, can you add a policy override?
opsbot: applied routing override for customer ACME -> prefer: flashattn_variant. Takes ~15s to propagate.
deploy-bot: Rollout r-2024-11-05-A flagged: attn_hysteresis:true, sdpa_prefer:true, changed by sahil.
maria: after override metrics: p99 back to baseline in 3 mins for ACME. confirms kernel selection was root cause.
sahil: long term: we need better cost/latency cost function — for seq_len<=64 & batch<=4 we should prefer flashattn unless SDPA measurably wins in perf probe.
chris: agree. also noticed kernel prep overhead (permute buffers) adds ~40-60ms for tiny batches. need a fast path bypass.
jen: created issue ENG-RT-2143: "kernel selector: add microbench probe and hysteresis decay tuning for short sequences". assigned to chris + sahil.
maria: customer updated to say they were fine, but asked for post-mortem. can we give a clear RCA + mitigation steps?
sahil: RCA draft: recent compileflag enabling sdpa permute fusion increased per-request kernel setup time for small batches, causing regressions in p99 for short-sequence chat workloads. Rollout selector then started preferring sdpa for some customers. Mitigation was routing override to flashattn + rollback plan for compile flag.
chris: also confirm no billing impact. cost per token unchanged.
jen: next actions: 1) revert SDPA_FUSE_PERMUTE on canary, 2) add microprobe to selector, 3) publish guidance in /docs/runtime/attn-kernels.md about when to prefer flashattn vs sdpa.
maria: i'll prepare customer-facing summary and include timeline + mitigation steps.
opsbot: Revert scheduled? none yet. need approve from sahil or release owner.
sahil: I'll approve revert on canary and start a controlled rollback. tagging release window 02:40-02:50.
chris: add automated test: perf harness that runs short-seq microbench on both kernels when compileflag toggles.
jen: adding that to ENG-RT-2143.
maria: thanks all. closing loop with ACME in ~30m. :thumbsup:
